KPM – Xbox Controls for KOTOR 1 Description

KPM – Xbox Controls for KOTOR 1 adds an Xbox-style control scheme for Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic on PC.

The layout is inspired by the original Xbox controls while making adjustments where necessary to work better with the PC version of the game and KPM. Requirements / Important Notes

For use with Kotor Patch Manager.

This patch is XInput only.

If you're using a PlayStation controller or another non-XInput gamepad, you'll need third-party software to make the controller appear as an XInput device.

As far as I know, KPM does not run through Steam Input.

Make sure Enhanced Keyboard Control is unchecked in KPM when using this patch. 

Installation:

- Locate your KPM installation.
- Open the Patches folder.
- Place K1XboxControls.kpatch inside the Patches folder.
- Launch KPM.
- If Enhanced Keyboard Control is currently checked, uncheck it.
- Check Xbox Controls K1.
- Apply Patches
- Make sure your ingame keybinds and keyboard settings are set to default

Controls

LT / RT — Cycle targets
LB — Pause gameplay
RB — Switch characters
A — Default action
B — Back / cancel last action
X — Stealth, if a Stealth Field Generator is equipped
Y — Disengage combat
Select — Solo Mode
Start — Options menu
LS — Flourish weapon
RS — First-person free look
D-Pad — Directional menu navigation and action/hotbar navigation
Right Stick Up / Down — Scroll menu information box
Left Stick — Move player with a walk/run threshold similar to console
Right Stick Left / Right — Horizontal camera movement

Right-Stick Sensitivity

Right-stick camera sensitivity can be adjusted using the in-game Mouse Sensitivity setting. Mouse Cursor

The mouse cursor remains enabled by default.

Press F9 to park and hide the mouse cursor for controller-only play.

Press F9 again to restore it. Action Bar / Hot Menu Navigation

Similar to KOTOR 2 on PC with the Aspyr controller interface, using the D-Pad to navigate the action bar or hot menu moves menu focus to that interface.

While an action is focused, pressing A performs the corresponding action.

To defocus the action bar or hot menu, press B. Menu Controls

Some menus use controller buttons for actions shown on the lower portion of the interface. This is similar to KOTOR 2 and the console versions of KOTOR.

Button prompts for these menu actions have not been added yet.

Common menu controls include:

A — Primary action, such as Load Game, Get All Items, or Buy
B — Cancel / back out of a menu
X — Secondary action, such as switching to Sell Items
Y — Third menu action where applicable
Select — Fourth menu action where applicable

The exact function depends on the menu currently open. Compatibility

This patch is designed specifically for KPM and uses XInput controller input.

PlayStation controllers and other non-XInput controllers will require third-party software that provides XInput emulation.
